Hi Alex —

Congrats on the spike this week! I noticed BrightForge crossed the 100k token threshold on the self-serve plan — great signal. I work with accounts like yours to run a short, practical 15-minute session that covers:
- how to reduce token cost with prefix caching and batching settings we recommend
- model/quantization tradeoffs for typical BrightForge sequences
- a one-page runbook I can drop into your ops playbook (attached)

Would 15 minutes early next week work? Here are three windows I have available (all PT):
- Mon 7/30, 10:00–10:15am PT
- Tue 7/31, 2:30–2:45pm PT
- Wed 8/1, 11:00–11:15am PT

If none of these fit, reply with a couple of slots that do and I’ll send a calendar invite + a quick Zoom link. No sales pitch — purely tactical. I’ve attached the mini runbook so you can skim first.

Thanks,
Ben
